mandatory_invariants: every plane has an independent version and rollback boundary
embedding, belief, activation, efficacy and topology are distinct state types
inference topology is frozen inside an episode
no training answer, verdict rationale or new lesson text enters receiver prompts
all comparison arms have equal information and compute envelopes
slow memory requires fresh, retention, exception and rollback gates
consensus is claim-local and preserves dissent
correlated evidence is not counted as independent support
structural epochs allow one mutation class at a time
branching ratio stays below one by default and approaches criticality only in sealed utility-risk comparisons
criticality and consciousness are never inferred from task score alone
scientific progress requires preregistration, real execution, receipt and independent judgment

stages: WORLD-R real domain and time-disjoint replication
factor_switches: hidden regime shift and delayed outcome
private function observations and restricted ports
asymmetric Agent A and Agent B capabilities
call, token, latency and communication budgets
missing function or topology requiring development

experiment_ladder.primary_kill: role labels or information deletion explain the gain
pairwise baseline is within +/-2pp of full
full context matches performance or unstable runs exceed 5 percent
credit, eligibility or rollback does not remove at least 70 percent of gain
information action has no equal-budget regret or calibration benefit
append-only matches or rare exceptions are systematically erased
agreement rises while truth/calibration falls or shuffled donor matches
fixed architecture matches or complexity-adjusted gain is non-positive
plane rollback is not selectively necessary for its preregistered capability

rivals: predictive or active-inference agent without persistent semantic topology
